capabilities: insert code blocks via hotkeys with a fuzzy-searchable language picker
wrap selected text in fences, including text that already contains fences
change the language of an existing code block
remove fences from a code block while keeping the code
paste clipboard contents as a new code block
extras: The manifest carries an automated-review notice: "This plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff."
problem: Inserting a fenced code block in Obsidian means manually typing triple backticks and remembering the exact language identifier.

relations.evidence: The full list is powered by Prism.js syntax highlighting.

summary: Code block insertion helper that adds hotkeys and a searchable language picker for creating, retitling, and unwrapping fenced code blocks.
